ns2:course.label: Mechanics of Wood Materials
ns2:course.description: (NRES 332) Examines the static strength properties and structural designs of wood and wood-based materials. Students conduct the standard strength property tests on wood and wood composites, as well as non-wood fibrous material. Topics include the designing of wood beams and columns. Factors related to the derivation of allowable stresses of wood materials are also discussed. Prerequisite: PHYS 101 or PHYS 140.
